Engineered for Low Latency and System Integrity

An exploration of high-performance backend design concepts mapped into a modern React and Next.js full-stack system.

Binary Heap Book

Bid and Ask queues are represented as binary heaps. Max-heap for bids offers O(1) retrieval of the best bid; Min-heap for asks offers O(1) of the best ask. Sub-microsecond insertion complexity O(log n).

Price-Time Priority matching

Implements strict Price-Time priority (FIFO). Best price fills first. For identical price levels, execution order is decided purely by submission timestamp to prevent front-running.

WebSocket Streaming

Leverages a bidirectional socket connection to broadcast market updates in real time. Orderbook snapshots, transaction trades, and client portfolios update instantly without polling overhead.

Event-Sourced Persistence

All trade executions are logged as an append-only transaction ledger on Upstash Redis. Book state can be fully recovered from scratch by replaying the trade log.

Mark-to-Market Portfolio

Computes portfolio metrics on-the-fly. Evaluates average cost basis, realized P&L from closed positions, and unrealized mark-to-market returns dynamically.

Scale-Out Ready

Engineered with a single-threaded message queue pipeline per ticker to eliminate race conditions without complex concurrency locking patterns, mimicking industrial LMAX Disruptor frameworks.
